pr_body:
Previously, this method would infinitely retry on non context cancelled errors. However, the disk usage runner uses a done channel to signal completion, rather than cancelling the context.

This change limits the amount of retries attempted, so the runner can check the done channel and exit.

Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/134611
Epic: none
Release note: none

review_comments:
Realized I was completely misusing the `retry` package, and it wasn't actually retrying. Switched to the roachprod retry instead :) 

Want to double check my retry reasoning here though. We want to retry here since we are parsing the result and a stray warning can throw that off. We don't need to retry in `saveDiskUsageToLogsDir` since we are just writing to logs and the warnings are benign.

> We want to retry here since we are parsing the result and a stray warning can throw that off. We don't need to retry in saveDiskUsageToLogsDir since we are just writing to logs and the warnings are benign.

Exactly! If `grep` fails to match a number, the entire command exits with an error, which would trigger a retry attempt.
Let's add a description... something of the form, "GetDiskUsageInBytes executes the command `du {store-dir}`. Optional `args` are appended."
